description: Blend of the hedonic model and the peer-group baseline, per property category: log(prediction) = w*log(model) + (1-w)*log(baseline). Values are COPIED from the configuration chosen by 5-fold cross-validation on the train split (blend_selection in docs/validation/price_model_selection.json); do not edit by hand: re-run src/quality/price_model_selection.py and copy the new values.
selection: lowest out-of-fold MAE on the train split; the plain model (ridge 1, w 1, no pooled rule) is kept unless beaten by 0.1%
